授業科目の概要.対象学部等: 生命機能科学専攻　Department of Bioscience & Biotechnology

授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項: The language of instruction is English. The instructor will present lecture materials during the allotted time on each lecture day, and the lecture will be based on those materials. A report assignment will be given for each lecture, so please submit your report by the deadline. Your report will be evaluated based on its content.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
Genetic resources are essential experimental materials to promote agriculture and life science research. In this class, we learn noble properties and potential’s ability about genetic resources, and their management and development methods will be given.
The main target organisms are insect (silkworm), plant (rice), and microorganisms (antibiotic-producing Streptomyces, lactic acid bacteria, thermophilic bacteria). This lecture will be also included about the handling of the genetic intellectual property.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Biological resources, life sciences, intellectual property, agricultural organisms
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: It is desirable to have studied biology and molecular genetics.
